name: Desktop Computer
instruction: Hey, can you create a 3D model of a desktop computer? It should include a monitor, a CPU tower, a keyboard, and a mouse. The monitor should be flat and rectangular, while the CPU tower should have a few buttons and ports on the front. Arrange the keyboard and mouse in front of the monitor.

Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The monitor is elevated above the keyboard and mouse.
The CPU tower is positioned to the side or below the monitor.
Object distance and contact: The components of the desktop computer should not overlap each other.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified components are included in the model.
The arrangement of the keyboard and mouse in front of the monitor is correctly executed.
